purpose: Phase-7C Section 3 innate immune runtime coefficients. Real deterministic computation of macrophage (continuum), NK, dendritic-cell, antigen-presentation, innate integration and adaptive-priming potential from validated upstream inputs (tumour visibility / antigen availability / immune accessibility / vascular access / treatment-induced damage) using the shared aggregation + confidence frameworks. All weights registry-driven; prediction-only; schematic normalized [0,1]. Availability-gated: a missing input yields UNAVAILABLE, never zero.

macrophage.polarization_axis_note: axis = tumor_opposing - tumor_supporting in [-1,1]; tumor_supporting = 1 - tumor_opposing (schematic complement).

coefficient_policy.valid_range: every score in [0,1]; macrophage axis in [-1,1]
coefficient_policy.source: general innate tumour-immunology biology applied predictively
coefficient_policy.sensitivity_note: cytotoxic/presentation potentials are derived AFTER availability + activation, never assumed from availability alone; adaptive priming potential FEEDS Section 4.
coefficient_policy.limitations: No macrophage/NK/DC count or marker; no cytokine level (all NOT_REPORTED).
